data: Why does the running time of each model varies, and how are they affected?

The running time of each model varies due to differences in their computational complexity and efficiency. The T-TA models generally have lower running times compared to the biLM models across all word counts. This is because T-TA models are designed to be more efficient than biLM models. Additionally, the running times for both T-TA and biLM models increase with the number of words, but the rate of increase is higher for biLM models. This suggests that biLM models may have a higher computational cost per word compared to T-TA models.
